questions.questionTextEn: The average elevation of Tibetan Plateau above sea level is –
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2013 ; I.A.S. (Pre) 1994] The average elevation of Tibetan Plateau above sea level is –
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) 5 Km. Tibetan Plateau is also known as Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau. questions.questionTextEn: Which is known as 'Roof of the World'?
questions.questionTextHi: [44th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2000] Which is known as 'Roof of the World'?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Pamir. The Pamir Plateau or the “Pamir’’ is called the roof of the world because of its high altitude. The southern border of Central Asia is determined by Pamir Plateau. It is a convergence of many mountains. [44th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2000]
